record.paper_title: Model Theory of Tame Valued Fields and Beyond: Recent Developments and Open Questions
record.context_brief: Extremality under composition: does extremality of components with divisible coarse part imply extremality of the composition?
record.original_question: A valued field (K, v) is called extremal if for every multivariate polynomial f(X_1,...,X_n) over K, the set of values {v(f(a_1,...,a_n)) | a_i in O_K} has a maximal element in vK union {infinity}, where O_K is the valuation ring. A valuation v on K is said to be a composition v = w ∘ w-bar if there are valuations w and w-bar such that w is a coarsening of v (i.e., every v-open set is w-open) and w-bar is the valuation induced by v on the residue field Kw of w, so that (K, v) maps into (K, w) with residue (Kw, w-bar). It is known that if v = w ∘ w-bar and w has divisible value group, then both w and w-bar can be studied using the structure of v. Is it true that: if both w and w-bar are extremal and w has divisible value group, then v = w ∘ w-bar is also extremal?

evidence.quote: Open problem 11: If v = w ∘ w-bar with w and w-bar extremal and w has divisible value group, does it follow that v is extremal?

artifact.status_search_result: The behavior of extremality under composition of valuations is an active research topic on extremal and tame valued fields (Kuhlmann and collaborators). Partial results show that extremality with divisible value group and perfect residue field is compatible with composition, but the precise question—whether extremality of both components, with the outer valuation having divisible value group, implies extremality of the composition—is listed among open problems with no published resolution found.

status_evidence.title: Notes on extremal and tame valued fields
status_evidence.snippet: Studies extremality of valued fields and discusses behavior under composition of valuations and divisibility hypotheses.
status_evidence.claim: Extremality interacts with composition of valuations under divisibility/perfectness assumptions, but a full criterion remains incomplete.

status_evidence.title: Characterization of extremal valued fields
status_evidence.snippet: Characterizes extremal valued fields under tameness/divisibility hypotheses; open questions remain about more general settings.
